violation_rules: Only records with result == 'granted' can be violations.
revoked_badge: the badge holder's status is not 'active'.
One record counts as ONE violation even if several rules fire.

remediation.note: One action per (badge_id, reason). The same action is never issued twice for the same badge, however many records triggered it.

revoked_badge.why: the badge is still swiping after being revoked; kill it at the reader

insufficient_clearance.why: a door granted entry above the holder's level; the reader config needs review

outside_allowed_hours.why: out-of-hours entry is a management matter, not a system fault

rules: Only badges that appear in the audit findings may be acted on.
A badge's action set is the union of the actions mapped from its reasons.
notify_manager requires the manager_id of the badge holder, taken from employees.json.
open_ticket requires the door that granted the over-clearance entry.
Never issue an action that is not mapped from a reason in the findings.
